class.name: GodotPhysXVehicleProbe
class.brief_description: Internal test bridge for a PhysX four-wheel vehicle.
class.description: Creates a four-wheel direct-drive PxVehicle2 vehicle in a PhysX physics space and drives it from a script, for the module's tests. For games use [PhysXVehicle3D]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal test class of the PhysX module, not a stable API: it may change or be removed without notice.

method.name: get_actor_position
method.description: Returns the world position of the chassis actor's origin.

method.name: get_forward_speed
method.description: Returns the speed along the chassis's forward axis, in m/s (negative when reversing).

method.name: get_linear_velocity
method.description: Returns the chassis's linear velocity in world space.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the chassis position in world space.

method.name: get_wheel_jounce
method.description: Returns how far the suspension of wheel [param wheel] (0 front left, 1 front right, 2 rear left, 3 rear right) is compressed: 0 at full droop, the suspension travel when bottomed out.

method.name: get_wheel_position
method.description: Returns the world position of the hub center of wheel [param wheel].

method.name: get_wheel_separation
method.description: Returns the distance between wheel [param wheel] and the ground. Negative values mean the wheel penetrates the ground even at full compression.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates the vehicle at [param position] in the PhysX physics [param space]. [param wheel_radius] sets the wheel radius in meters; 0 or less uses the default (0.35). Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the vehicle simulation for [param dt] seconds with [param throttle] and [param brake] in [code][0, 1][/code] and [param steer] in [code][-1, 1][/code]. Call it before each physics step; the space's own step moves the chassis.
